title: Distinguish explicit null from malformed references
task_type: Unity Editor asset and build verification
environment: One-slot synthetic Variant controls. Array-size changes, multi-level precedence and export were not established by this evidence.
goal: Project a serialized material-slot override and realize its intended value.
approach: Historical failed assumption: A reference without a GUID was assumed to be uniformly unknown.
what_worked: Historical correction: Retain valid null as a known slot-clear operation. Keep nonzero references without GUIDs and zero references with invalid GUIDs unresolved. Require exact occurrence/native receipts before clearing live slots. Verification reported by the source: Unity 2022.3.22f1 authored RED became parser/projection GREEN. A separate exact-witness direct native realization and save/reopen control passed; the historical normal nested import path was still native-missing at that checkpoint.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: A Unity-authored explicit fileID: 0 override was discarded and reported unresolved.
why: Confirmed: the parser conflated an explicit null value with incomplete non-null references.
improved_method: Model absent, explicit null, and malformed references separately. Verify live clearing independently from parsed-state correctness.
when_to_use: One-slot synthetic Variant controls. Array-size changes, multi-level precedence and export were not established by this evidence.
when_not_to_use: Array-size changes, multi-level precedence and export were not established by this evidence.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
